summary: Pearson PLC filed a Form 6-K attaching a TR-1 notification of major holdings. The filing discloses that Artisan Partners Limited Partnership crossed above a threshold and now holds 12.02% of Pearson's voting rights (72,267,456 shares) as of June 24, 2026, up from 11.01% previously. This is a routine regulatory disclosure under UK disclosure rules (mapped to a Schedule 13D/G filing in the US) of a passive stake increase. No board action, deal terms, or corporate event is involved. There is no special situation to monitor.
